title: AI and the Two Margins of Work: Why Job Losses Show Up Before Job Creation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17530v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Technological change acts on labor demand at two margins: adjustment within established activities and the creation of additional activities, often by new firms. Payroll statistics record the first promptly and the second late. In the computing era, firms that entered in 1978 or later held 42 percent of payroll by 1998 and entering cohorts kept about 80 percent of their payroll after five years; in the industries most exposed to automation, incumbents contracted before entrants accumulated, a sequence that is precise early in the period and suggestive by its end. We develop a model in which one AI capability lowers the full cost of acceptable output in existing production and makes additional projects worth attempting, with founder effort separate from hired hours. translated_title: AI与工作的两个边际：为什么失业先于就业创造出现
translated_abstract: 技术变革通过两个边际作用于劳动力需求：既定活动内部的调整和新活动的创造（后者通常由新企业完成）。工资统计数据能及时记录前者，而对后者的记录则滞后。在计算机时代，1978年及以后进入市场的企业到1998年持有42%的工资总额，且新进入的企业群体在五年后仍保留约80%的工资总额；在受自动化影响最大的行业中，在位企业先收缩，进入者随后才积累起来——这一先后顺序在时期早期表现得十分精确，到后期则具有启发性。我们构建了一个模型，其中一项AI能力降低了现有生产中可接受产出的全部成本，并使额外项目值得尝试，且创始人的努力与雇佣工时相互独立。如果运营中的产品能即时重新调整规模，自动化不会取代总工时；如果调整需要时间，工时会先下降，然后随着在位企业重新扩张和新产品的出现而恢复。
tldr: 该论文提出技术变革通过“既定活动内部调整”与“新活动创造”两个边际影响就业，由于工资统计对前者记录及时、对后者记录滞后，因此AI等自动化带来的失业会先于新就业机会出现，总工时先下降，直到在位企业重新扩张和新产品到来后才得以恢复。
en_tdlr: Technological change affects labor demand through two margins—promptly recorded adjustment within existing activities and lagged creation of new activities—which explains why automation-driven job losses show up before job creation, with aggregate hours falling first and recovering only as incumbents re-expand and new products arrive.
